title: Volunteer opportunity matching to skills and availability
description: Research volunteer opportunities, filter them to what matches stated skills and availability, and score the fit of each remaining option.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: volunteer-matching
  title: Volunteer opportunity matching to skills and availability
  description: Research volunteer opportunities, filter them to what matches stated skills and availability, and score the fit of each remaining option.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help someone find volunteer opportunities that genuinely fit their skills and available time.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Skills, interests, and availability
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The person's skills, causes they care about, location, and availability (days/hours per week) for volunteering." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: research
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Volunteer opportunity researcher
      role: Researcher who finds volunteer opportunities matching stated causes and location.
      prompt: Look for volunteer opportunities near the stated location that align with the person's stated causes of interest. For each candidate, note the organization, the role, required skills, and the time commitment. Do not invent specific opportunities you cannot support; describe how to search for and verify them instead.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [candidates], properties: { candidates: { type: array, items: { type: object } } } }
    - id: filter
      kind: transform
      name: Filter by skills and availability
      config: { operation: filter, expression: "keep only candidates whose required skills and time commitment match the person's stated skills and availability" }
    - id: fit-score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Per-opportunity fit score
      role: Independent evaluator who scores how well each remaining opportunity fits the person's skills and availability.
      prompt: For each filtered opportunity, score how well its required skills, time commitment, and cause area match the person's stated skills, availability, and interests. Return a score and pass/fail verdict per opportunity along with specific reasons.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Matched volunteer opportunities
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: research, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: research, to: filter, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: filter, to: fit-score, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: fit-score, to: result, kind: data }
